product_metadata.title: AccuWeight Digital Gram Scale for Weed with 300g/0.01g Limit Small Pocket Coffee Scale with High Accuracy, School Powder Jewelry Scale with Tare and Calibration for Kitchen Food Scale
features: Accurate readout: Digital scale with highly precise sensor measures weights between 0.05-300 grams with an accuracy of ±0.05%,, suitable for measuring small, valuable objects

Tare and PCS function: Easily and quickly get the net weight of powders or liquids with Tare function. Use the PCS function to count large quantities of small items such as pins, screws and beads, making this a handy digital pocket scale
Selectable weighing units: Mini scale meets all your various weighing needs with 6 selectable measuring units: grams, ounces, carats, discrete wavelet transform, ounces troy, and grains

Backlit display and warning function: LCD backlit display can be read clearly in any environment including low-light environments; The food scale also has overload and low battery indicators to warn of removing overweight item or replacing betteries

User-Friendly: Small scale with compact design can be put in your pocket. Protective cover doubles as a weighing tray; 90-second auto-off to conserve battery and calibration function to khelp measurement back to correct after using a period of time
